leads.claim: AARO is tasked with the secure handling, storage, transport, and transfer of UAP objects and material for scientific and technical exploitation.
leads.why: The document explicitly outlines a formal government program structure for the custody and exploitation of UAP material.
leads.custody_chain: AARO, in partnership with Joint Staff and counterintelligence elements.
leads.government_response: The document establishes this as an official function of the AARO mission.
leads.quote: Advises Commands on the secure and safe handling, storage, transport, and transfer of UAP Objects and Material

leads.claim: AARO directs the exploitation of recovered enigmatic technologies through cross-sector partnerships and research laboratories.
leads.why: The text confirms the existence of a program dedicated to the exploitation of recovered technologies.
leads.custody_chain: AARO and research partners, including Department of Energy (DoE) laboratories.
leads.government_response: The document codifies this as an active mission requirement.
